### 🐛 Describe the bug

When using VLLM_USE_MODELSCOPE and the tensor-parallel-size > 1,
I found that vllm will download the model many times (eq to tensor-parallel-size)
This makes start up slowly. And failed.

the started command:
```
python3 -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server --model deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5b --tensor-parallel-size 2 --dtype half
```
